scope: Three secondary community references Vapor, Fray, Remnant translated to mask-only PHG rendering candidates

entries.name: Vapor
entries.prompt: Correct the SECOND image, the generated Vapor biomask, using the FIRST image (the original community RGB256x257 screenshot) as the geometry authority. Keep the second image's neutral PHG PBR quality, grayscale/silver/charcoal paint, controlled metal roughness, upper-left/front soft key/fill, same near-front camera and exact existing macro panels/eye inserts/ridges. The current second image's shell is too narrow by about8-10percent and the lower muzzle/chin is too elongated and pointed. Restore the actual broader helmet proportions of the FIRST image: its visible rigid shell fits approximately source pixel rectangle[63,22,194,188], only a manual review guide, NOT a crop or certified segmentation. The true hard bottom ends around source y183-186 with a short flattened/bluntly rounded termination under the central vertical plates. The longer thin white strands descending to y210 and below are DREADLOCKS, not a long chin. Shorten and blunt the generated central lower face to that reference termination, including its flanking cheek lower edges, rather than retaining a dagger point. Make the rounded upper crown modestly broader at the same whole-mask height to match the first image; width/height of the solid mask about0.79 instead of0.71. This is a sculptural proportion correction using the reference, not a simple global stretch. Preserve the same four long arched charcoal upper leaf panels with raised silver borders, shallow central top notch/forked spine, pale non-glowing narrow eye inserts, small central bridge and existing long parallel lower raised channels. Keep all panel line positions/relationships and coarse relief recognizable; no extra vent, grille, new gap, rune, letter, ornament, screw, horn or hidden side/back surface. The source is low resolution, so no invented tiny details. Remove every wearer/head/hair/dreadlock/bead/body/armor and black source background. Only one complete isolated rigid mask on TRUE transparent RGBA. No background rectangle, floor, shadow plane, halo, text or UI. Center the whole corrected solid shell at about78-80percent of canvas longest axis, with at least10percent transparent empty margin above and below and on both sides. Keep a front view consistent with the original screenshot, not a new angle.

attempts.prompt:
Edit the attached reference into ONE isolated detachable biomask asset only. This is a 256x257 grayscale secondary community reference, not certified original PHG art. Preserve THIS visible design strictly, same straight near-front camera and perspective, same silhouette, width-height proportions, existing panel boundaries, eye shape, visible engravings and wear distribution. Translate only the rendering into a polished realistic PBR asset consistent with Predator: Hunting Grounds: neutral soft studio key from image upper left and front, gentle fill revealing structure, clear controlled rough metal surfaces, restrained highlights, low grain, no universal mirror chrome. Preserve grayscale/silver/charcoal tonal organization; source color/albedo is unknown, so introduce no color. Treat fine microdetail as uncertain and do not manufacture runes, text, glyphs, holes, vents, horns, extra trim, fittings or new seams. Do not reconstruct invisible profile/back geometry. Keep the camera view fixed; no invented three-quarter angle. Remove all surrounding white and grey hanging dreadlocks, wearer skin/head, hair, body, armor below the mask and every black background pixel. Those long thin strands belong to the wearer and are NOT part of the biomask. Keep ONLY the visible detached solid face shell, existing small mask side plates and lower face plate. True transparent RGBA background, no ground, shadow plane, halo, vignette, UI, caption or text. Center the complete mask with 8-12 percent empty transparent margin on every edge, largest visible mask axis about 78-82 percent of the canvas. Do not clip the top or chin. Exactly one mask, no side views or duplicates.

DESIGN VAPOR: The reference mask has a tall rounded domed crown. A narrow charcoal central spine forks into a shallow V at its top; the upper crown is divided into four long curved dark leaf-shaped panels bounded by bright raised silver edges. Preserve these four elongated panels, their taper toward the central bridge, and the dark central top channel. Broad silver brow sweeps into two narrow long diagonal eye slits. The source eye inserts are pale bright grey/white, so retain pale non-glowing reflective inserts rather than invent dark or colored eyes. Preserve the little central bridge ridge and long silver split/tapered lower mouth shield with parallel vertical raised channels. Keep the restrained silver lateral cheeks and the original lower-point termination. The many long white strands outside and below the shell are entirely removed as dreadlocks. Do not shorten the tall forehead or broaden the lower face.

Same straight near-front view.
